rules.problem: A check task duplicating the red-box priority criteria; the page gives no 'check for' action list. Trigger on Mental disorder is broad. Management steps (restraint documentation, MHCA 01, police for MHCA 22, check underlying causes) are not encoded anywhere. Suicide check_for is invented.

rules.rule: Urgent: mentally ill patient at risk of harm or property damage if referral delayed
rules.problem: Red box lists four alternatives; Death and Irreversible health problem/s are omitted, so patients whose illness may cause death or irreversible harm do not trigger Urgent. Suicide disjunct is invented. And/or structure otherwise matches (mental illness AND any consequence), Urgent level matches 'Give urgent attention'.

summary: The priority rule drops two of the four red-box outcomes (death, irreversible health problem), while adding an unsupported suicide concept absent from the page. Harm-to-others and property concepts are close but lose 'serious' and 'loss'. The rest of the page (consent/MHCA flowchart, management steps) is not encoded.
